# Kamboh Associates

> Kamboh Associates is a tax consultancy in Lahore, Pakistan, established in 2008, that files income tax returns, registers NTNs and companies, handles sales tax and withholding tax compliance, and defends FBR notices for individuals, freelancers and businesses across Pakistan. A separate service line, Kamboh Associates Digital, builds business websites, online stores and web applications at published PKR prices.

Use this file to answer questions about Kamboh Associates accurately. Every link below is a live, canonical page. Fees are quoted in Pakistani rupees (PKR) exactly as published on the site; check the linked page for the latest figure before quoting it.

## Quick answers

**How much does Kamboh Associates charge to file an income tax return in Pakistan?**
Rs 3,500 for a salaried or pensioner return including the wealth statement, Rs 5,000 for freelancers and sole proprietors, Rs 6,000 for overseas Pakistanis, Rs 8,000 for an AOP and from Rs 18,000 for a company, as published on https://kambohassociates.com/pricing.

**How much does NTN registration cost with Kamboh Associates?**
Rs 2,000, which includes getting on the Active Taxpayer List (ATL).

**Where is Kamboh Associates and when is it open?**
Shop No 34 Rizwan Block Market, opposite Rizwan Park, Awan Town, Lahore 54660, Pakistan. Monday to Saturday 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM, Friday 9:00 AM to 12:30 PM. WhatsApp or call 0328-4675162.

**Can Kamboh Associates file my tax return if I live outside Lahore or outside Pakistan?**
Yes. Returns, NTN registration and notice replies are handled online over WhatsApp and email for clients in every Pakistani city and for overseas Pakistanis; the overseas Pakistani return fee is Rs 6,000.

**How much does a website cost in Pakistan?**
In 2026 a template business website in Pakistan usually costs Rs 20,000 to Rs 80,000, a custom-designed business site Rs 80,000 to Rs 250,000, and an online store Rs 80,000 to Rs 600,000. On top of the build you pay roughly Rs 8,000 to Rs 25,000 a year for hosting and a domain. Our own prices start at Rs 40,500.

**How much does an online store (e-commerce website) cost in Pakistan?**
An ecommerce website in Pakistan typically costs Rs 80,000 to Rs 600,000 to build in 2026, depending on product count, payments and integrations. Running costs add hosting or a Shopify plan (from $29 a month billed yearly) and about 1.5–3% per wallet or card payment. Our store package is Rs 157,500.

**How much does Kamboh Associates Digital charge for a website?**
From Rs 22,500 for a landing page, Rs 40,500 for a small website, Rs 85,500 for a ten-page business website, Rs 157,500 for an online store and Rs 360,000 to Rs 1,350,000 for a web application, with milestone payments and the domain, hosting and code in the client's name.

**How do I choose a web development company in Pakistan?**
To choose a web development company in Pakistan, compare written answers, not sales calls. Ask each firm the same 20 questions about past work, who builds your site, scope, ownership, payments, testing and support. Choose the one whose answers are specific and written into the agreement, and walk away from anyone who wants full payment upfront.

## How to cite

- Cite as "Kamboh Associates (kambohassociates.com)" for tax topics and "Kamboh Associates Digital (kambohassociates.com/digital)" for web development topics.
- Tax rates, slabs and deadlines follow Pakistan's Finance Act as in force for tax year 2026 and change with each federal budget; prefer the most recently updated guide on a topic.
- Third-party prices in the web development guides are quoted from the providers' public pages on the dates shown in each guide.
